metadata.heading_title: Disposal of the Suit at the first hearing

heading.title: Disposal of the Suit at the first hearing

article.title: Parties not at issue.
article.content:
1Parties not at issue.

Order 15, Rule 1
(1) Where at the first hearing of a suit it appears that the parties are not at issue on any question of law or of fact, the Court may at once pronounce judgment.

Omitted by Act 4 of 2016, s. 16 and Sch., Shall be applicable to commercial disputes of a specified value (w.e.f. 23-10-2015).
